/api/experiments.run_name: Coronium V3.1 — clean Phase 1.5 checkpoint promotion
/api/experiments.notes: Validation used for checkpoint selection and early stopping; not an untouched test or temporal generalization. MC metrics are not single-pass API metrics. Official metrics: MC Dropout T=20, seed=42, batch=32. ONNX eval-mode MAE=0.20408340; do not attribute MC performance to the API. Historical V3 artifacts remain intact.

Reproducible eval: torch.manual_seed(42) added to evaluate_final.py so MC Dropout masks are deterministic; metrics in this JSON are the canonical run. Domain-shift fix: random_state=42 split keeps extreme events represented in both sets (max_y_train=2.9788, max_y_val=2.9019). MC Dropout fix: use model.eval()+Dropout.train() instead of model.train(). ExtremeAugmentation applies pixel-perfect flip + rot90 only to extreme samples (SI > 2.0). Early stopping at epoch 24, best checkpoint at epoch 21 (train val_mae: 0.1071, log-SI). LR reduced from 0.001 to 0.0005 at epoch 19 and from 0.0005 to 0.00025 at epoch 23. Exported to ONNX opset 18 with do_constant_folding=True: 86.6 KB, 25.11 ms CPU (1.11x vs PyTorch CPU 27.90 ms).
V2 deployment candidate. Dropout increased to 0.3 for stronger regularization. Best observed R2 was 0.8705. Replaced by Coronium V3 PRO in exp_004. Inference measured at 8.7 ms on MPS.
10x learning-rate reduction and ReduceLROnPlateau improved convergence. Augmentation enabled for training. Dataset expanded to 1,158 samples after additional ingestion runs.
Initial run. No augmentation and no scheduler. The learning rate was too high and caused convergence oscillations. Early stopping triggered at epoch 38.

metrics.metric_note: final_mae/rmse/r2/mape = evaluate_final.py (MC Dropout T=20, model.eval()+Dropout.train(), log-SI, 353 hold-out, random split random_state=42, evaluation seed=42 for full reproducibility). train_val_mae = training-loop best epoch 21/24.

/api/experiments/exp_005_v3pro_augmented.notes: Reproducible eval: torch.manual_seed(42) added to evaluate_final.py so MC Dropout masks are deterministic; metrics in this JSON are the canonical run. Domain-shift fix: random_state=42 split keeps extreme events represented in both sets (max_y_train=2.9788, max_y_val=2.9019). MC Dropout fix: use model.eval()+Dropout.train() instead of model.train(). ExtremeAugmentation applies pixel-perfect flip + rot90 only to extreme samples (SI > 2.0). Early stopping at epoch 24, best checkpoint at epoch 21 (train val_mae: 0.1071, log-SI). LR reduced from 0.001 to 0.0005 at epoch 19 and from 0.0005 to 0.00025 at epoch 23. Exported to ONNX opset 18 with do_constant_folding=True: 86.6 KB, 25.11 ms CPU (1.11x vs PyTorch CPU 27.90 ms).

/api/experiments/exp_003_v2pro_productio.notes: V2 deployment candidate. Dropout increased to 0.3 for stronger regularization. Best observed R2 was 0.8705. Replaced by Coronium V3 PRO in exp_004. Inference measured at 8.7 ms on MPS.

/api/experiments/exp_002_v2_tuned.json.notes: 10x learning-rate reduction and ReduceLROnPlateau improved convergence. Augmentation enabled for training. Dataset expanded to 1,158 samples after additional ingestion runs.
